messages:
leo: Terraform apply for project=redwood-prod gpu-bastion change was blocked by policy during pre-apply check. Getting OPA deny on the egress rule. Anyone able to eyeball?

aj: I see the plan. Looks like bastion-egress was set to 0.0.0.0/0. Why did we open global egress for the bastion?

leo: temporary change so vendor could fetch an NFS snapshot during canary work. I thought I scoped it to vendor CIDR but must have copy-pasted the var.

sre-oncall: heads up: we are in a freeze window until 18:00 UTC today for prod clusters. Per policy, infra changes need two approvers + security signoff. @carla please advise.

carla: security here. We can't approve anything that opens egress to internet without audit and rollback plan. Please attach the failing conftest/OPA output + the intended CIDR and TTL for the bail-case.

policy-bot: OPA deny: rule 'egress_open_to_internet' matched resource "google_compute_firewall.bastion-egress"
policy-bot: policy file: policies/network/egress.rego:42

leo: pasting Conftest output below:

```
FAIL - google_compute_firewall.bastion-egress
  rule: egress_open_to_internet
  message: "bastion egress allows 0.0.0.0/0"
  path: resources[0].values.allowed[0].cidr_blocks[0]
```

aj: proposal: change bastion egress to the vendor CIDR 203.0.113.0/24, introduce a var bastion_debug_allowed_cidrs = ["203.0.113.0/24"] and an automated revoke job that removes that CIDR after 72h. Add a terraform-cloud post-apply task to record the approval in our audit table.

carla: that approach could work. Conditions: 1) PR must include an explicit runbook (how to revoke early), 2) add terraform plan output to the PR, 3) include a log entry in our audit system, 4) security will run a manual check once the PR is up.

sre-oncall: also ensure the gpu-pool helm chart values don't set allow_global_egress: true anywhere for prod overlay. Last time a helm override caused a drift.

aj: noted. I'll create the PR with plan and conftest output attached, add the runbook and the revoke automation, and set reviewers to @leo and @carla. Requesting expedited review but will respect freeze gating if needed.

leo: thanks. tagging the oncall to watch for any follow-ups. If security gives the green, we'll schedule the apply outside the freeze or get emergency approval. :thumbsup:

carla: please also include a risk assessment (why vendor needs NFS access and why we can't use an internal relay) and confirm that the vendor IP is fixed. If any of those are unknown we won't sign off.

aj: will confirm vendor IP is static and add the risk assessment. PR target: EOD.

leo: appreciate it — will stay on hand for the review.
